description: Eighteen storeys of it, clad to about the tenth and bare floor plates above that, with the crane still standing off the north-west corner and tied in at three levels. The hoarding round the base is printed with the finished building, at dusk, from an angle that would put you in mid-air over the mews. Somebody has added the name in marker across the bottom of the hoarding and it has been scrubbed at rather than removed.
name: Rising Damp
